description: A woman demonstrates how to make a 'crispy glazed turkey broth bowl' in a home kitchen. The video opens with the finished dish — ground turkey and white rice in an orange broth, topped with sliced cucumbers and sesame seeds — then rewinds to show the process. She sears Butterball ground turkey (85% lean) in a pan with oil, salt, and garlic powder, breaking it up and letting it crisp. She adds sweet chili sauce, chopped scallions, and soy sauce to glaze the meat, then sets it aside. In a separate pot, she sautés garlic and scallions in sesame oil, adds red curry paste, then pours in coconut milk and broth, stirring until smooth. She seasons the simmering broth with honey and fresh lime juice. Finally, she assembles the bowl with rice, the glazed turkey, broth, cucumbers, and sesame seeds, and tastes it with enjoyment. The video includes the hashtag #ButterballPartner, indicating a sponsored collaboration. The overall tone is bright, friendly, and instructional. The creator then demonstrates the recipe process: cracking eggs into a bowl, adding sugar, milk, vanilla, melted butter, sifting in flour and cornstarch, whisking until smooth, straining the batter, and cooking thin crepes in a nonstick pan. Fresh mangoes are peeled and sliced, then each crepe is assembled with piped whipped cream and mango before being folded into a bundle.
